blurb.text: A country where grape growing in Anatolia goes back at least 7,000 years, and one of the first places Vitis vinifera was domesticated. It has the world's fifth-largest vineyard area, but only 3% to 15% of the harvest becomes wine. Sultaniye, Öküzgözü, Syrah and Boğazkere lead plantings.
